name: Push-Up

instructions.description: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder width and body in a straight line.
Brace your core and lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at about a forty-five-degree angle.
Keep your head neutral and avoid sagging through the hips.
Exhale as you press the floor away to return to the top position.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a pain-free range while maintaining full-body alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Adds upper-body pressing to a plank-like trunk position.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Place hands on a bench or wall to reduce load.

commentsNotes: Keep the ribs from flaring as you press.
Stop before neck or low-back alignment is lost.
